Step-by-step build

The full sequence from preparation to tuning. Choose your configuration and only the relevant steps remain.

Ctrl K
Important: the firmware is in development and this guide has not yet been verified on a running engine. Do not skip stages.

1. Choose your engine

The guide shows only the steps you need. Your choice is remembered in the browser.

2. Follow the stages

1. Preparation and safetyA first start always carries risk: backfire, fuel leak, starter shock.2. Connect the ECUMake sure the unit is alive and sees itself before touching any actuator.3. Describe the engineThe unit is universal, so first tell it what engine you have.4. Check the sensorsWith wrong sensors the unit calculates the wrong dose and the wrong angle.5. Check the actuatorsEach output must fire where intended. Engine stopped, no fuel.6. Set up the triggerThe foundation of everything. Cranking without fuel and without spark.7. TDC and sparkThe unit must know where top dead center of cylinder 1 is. Spark on, no fuel.8. Base mapsThe first start runs on numbers known to be safe.9. First startShort attempts, with a log review after each one.10. Finish the tuneThe engine runs. From here, small steps, always with a log.
